_comment: Controls the 6-touch weekly cold outreach sequence. Edit freely, no code changes needed.
_from_email_note: Switch to your own verified domain in Resend once set up.
_test_mode_note: true = EVERY email is redirected to test_recipient_email instead of the real lead, with the lead's name shown in the subject so you can verify formatting/copy safely. Set to false only once you've reviewed a few test sends and trust the output.

touches.subject: Quick note about {business_name}'s website & socials
touches.body:
Hi there,

I noticed {business_name}'s website {issue_line}. I put together a quick look at what it could look like fixed — attached below.

I run a small studio here in State College helping local businesses with website builds and ongoing social media management. If a refresh — or just more consistent posting — would help, happy to send over a couple options. No pressure either way.

Best,
{sender_name}

touches.subject: Following up — {business_name}
touches.body:
Hi again,

Just following up on my note about {business_name}'s website and social presence. Totally understand if it's not a priority right now — if it ever is, I'm here.

Best,
{sender_name}

touches.subject: Checking in — {business_name}
touches.body:
Hi,

Still happy to help whenever the timing's right — website refresh, social media management, or both. No obligation, just wanted to stay on your radar.

Best,
{sender_name}

touches.subject: One more thought — {business_name}
touches.body:
Hi,

A lot of the local businesses I work with start with just social media management before touching the website — often an easier first step. Happy to talk through what that could look like for {business_name} if useful.

Best,
{sender_name}

touches.subject: Still around — {business_name}
touches.body:
Hi,

Just another friendly check-in. If a website or social media refresh becomes useful down the line, I'm easy to reach.

Best,
{sender_name}

touches.subject: Last note — {business_name}
touches.body:
Hi one more time,

I'll leave this as my last check-in for now. If it's ever useful, feel free to reach out any time — no expiration on the offer.

Best,
{sender_name}
